title: Verified Measurement Credential -- Cross-Jurisdiction Recognition Map (August 2026)
context: 2026-08-26 -- Mapping the Council of AI verified measurement credential against EU, UK, US, and Singapore regulatory frameworks
body: A verified measurement credential is an Ed25519-signed benchmark record that proves an AI system was independently measured against a fixed board of 14 axes (Art-5 Prohibited Practices, Care, Detection, Governance, Swarm Safety, MCP Security, Jailbreak Resistance, Affect, AGI Readiness, ASI Containment, OS-Safety, Privacy, Cross-Jurisdiction, and Machine Readability). Each credential maps to specific regulatory evidence requirements across jurisdictions: (1) EU AI Act: Art 5 prohibition evidence (Annex IV paragraph 1a-1c), Art 50(2) machine-readable marking, Art 12 record-keeping for high-risk systems. (2) UK DRCF: 42 control objectives mapped across ICO/Ofcom/CMA/FCA (Summer 2026 audit framework). (3) US FedRAMP: OSCAL assessment-results skeleton, NIST AI RMF GenAI Profile (July 2026) mapping to AI 600-1 measurement points. (4) Colorado SB24-205: consequential decision documentation (Art 6-1-1703), bias audit requirement (Art 6-1-1704). (5) Singapore PDPA: Model AI Governance Framework v2.0 verification pathway. (6) ISO/IEC 42001:2023: Clause 9 performance evaluation evidence, crossing with ETSI GR SAI 005 gap analysis. The credential is not a self-attestation -- it is independently signed by the Council of AI measurement node (Ed25519 public key published at csoai.org/verify). Each credential embeds the full benchmark run: model identity, board axes, per-axis scores, timestamp, and operator attestation hash. The cross-jurisdiction map is maintained as a living document at csoai.org/verify/cross-jurisdiction.
